title: Maybe implies both possible and possibly not
premises: always [P:s]: maybe(content: P) -> possible(content: not P)
conclusion: possible(content: happy(theme: john)) ∧ possible(content: not happy(theme: john))

proof.formula: always [P:s]: maybe(content: P) -> possible(content: not P)
maybe(content: happy(theme: john)) -> possible(content: happy(theme: john))
maybe(content: happy(theme: john)) -> possible(content: not happy(theme: john))
possible(content: happy(theme: john)) ∧ possible(content: not happy(theme: john))
